unit: one MRI volume or source DICOM series per row; not individual exported 2D slices
readiness_boundary: Structural staging only; no clinical approval or training-readiness claim. Empty/pending templates return NOT_READY (exit 2).
endpoint_vocabulary: No endpoint vocabulary has been chosen. Pass --endpoint-label for every approved class after study endpoint review.
defaults_are_guidance_only: The header-only template does not populate defaults. Pending statuses intentionally fail validation.

cohort_id.description: Stable source cohort identifier across releases. All releases share external-versus-development assignment.

cohort_release.description: Exact version/release/accession; never silently mix releases.

cohort_role.description: Whole source cohort role, fixed before outcomes are inspected.

patient_id.description: Pseudonymous participant ID, stable across visits and releases within a cohort. Do not use names or infer identities from filenames.

global_patient_id.description: Optional pseudonymous linkage ID for a known shared participant across cohorts. Blank means linkage unavailable, not independence.

visit_id.description: Source visit/timepoint identifier; all visits of a participant remain in one split.

scan_id.description: Unique source MRI volume or series accession within a cohort release; one scan per row.

input_kind.description: One volumetric file or one directory containing a single source DICOM series. Never one row per exported slice.

modality.description: Source modality; this manifest is for MRI.

sequence.description: Source sequence description (e.g. T1, T2, FLAIR); retain source facts. Unknown is allowed and requires later compatibility review.

relative_file_path.description: Local file or DICOM-series directory relative to --data-root (default manifest directory). Absolute paths, parent traversal, URLs, and paths escaping root are rejected.

source_label.description: Unmodified clinical/source label. Never equate MCI with a public-image stage label without approved endpoint design.

endpoint_label.description: Approved endpoint label, blank until mapping is reviewed. Must be included in explicitly supplied --endpoint-label vocabulary.

label_mapping_status.description: Declared review status of source-to-endpoint mapping. Pending rows fail staging.

label_mapping_evidence.description: Protocol/reference documenting the approved label mapping; not generated from accuracy outcomes.

reference_standard.description: Source clinical diagnosis/adjudication instrument and timing basis; records why the label is meaningful.

split.description: Fixed participant-level assignment. external_test is exclusive to external cohorts.

access_status.description: Declared permission for this research use. The checker cannot itself verify a DUA or rights.

access_evidence.description: Local authorization/license/DUA reference sufficient for investigator review. Do not paste secrets or credentials.

deidentification_status.description: Declared review of raw identifiers and image privacy, including burned-in identifiers as applicable.

deidentification_evidence.description: Local de-identification/QC record reference. This tool does not inspect raw tags or images.

provenance_url.description: Authoritative dataset/release/descriptor URL or DOI. No network request is made.

license_or_dua.description: Specific dataset license or approved agreement/version.

age_years.description: Age at this scan, as provided by source; blank if unavailable. Numeric 0 through 120. Never estimate from MRI.

sex.description: Source-recorded sex, retaining documented source coding; blank if unavailable. Do not infer.

site.description: Acquisition site code if available; use allowed pseudonymous identifiers.

scanner_manufacturer.description: Source scanner manufacturer; blank if unavailable.

scanner_model.description: Source scanner model; blank if unavailable.

field_strength_t.description: Scanner field strength in tesla, if documented; numeric 0.01 through 20.

acquisition_date.description: Source-authorized or shifted scan date/timepoint; blank if unavailable. Keep provider privacy requirements.

clinical_assessment_date.description: Authorized/shifted clinical assessment date or relative timepoint; blank if unavailable.

notes.description: Selection/exclusion/metadata notes. Never include direct identifiers or guessed clinical labels.

grouping_rules: Group all visits and scans by (cohort_id, patient_id), across releases.
Use optional global_patient_id to link known shared participants across cohorts; missing links do not prove independence.
A source cohort_id cannot participate in both development and external_test, including across releases.
No identical resolved local path, duplicate scan_id within a release, or nested DICOM-series manifest paths. Content duplicates are not checked.
privacy: Keep raw files and populated patient manifests local in an approved environment. This tool does not upload or write reports. Review stdout before sharing.
